original_input: What is the difference between ne ... pas and ne ... jamais?
original_context: Learning note: Je ne parle pas français negates the statement; Je ne parle jamais français expresses never. In informal speech ne may be dropped, but the standard written pattern includes it. Synthetic practice discussion.
